summary: Pretended Networking reduces ECU communication and power use and must be left when normal network communication is required.

summary: A component that requests Pretended Networking mode changes provides a PPort typed by the designated SenderReceiverInterface.

title: React on the change of Pretended Networking mode
summary: A component that reacts to Pretended Networking mode changes provides an RPort typed by the designated ModeSwitchInterface.

title: Deﬁnition of an “old-world” dynamic-size array data type by means of an ApplicationArrayDataType
summary: An ApplicationArrayDataType without dynamicArraySizeProfile and with a variableSize ApplicationArrayElement is classified as an old-world dynamic-size array.

title: Deﬁnition of an “old-world” dynamic-size array data type by means of an ImplementationDataType
summary: An ImplementationDataType resolving to ARRAY with the specified variable-size element and 8-bit NONE-encoded base type is classified as an old-world dynamic-size array.

title: Deﬁnition of a “new-world” variable-size array data type by means of an ApplicationArrayDataType
summary: An ApplicationArrayDataType with dynamicArraySizeProfile and an element defining arraySizeHandling is classified as a new-world variable-size array.

title: Deﬁnition of a “new-world” variable-size array data type by means of an ImplementationDataType
summary: An ImplementationDataType with dynamicArraySizeProfile and a sub-element defining arraySizeHandling is classified as a new-world variable-size array.

title: Deﬁnition of proﬁles for the deﬁnition of Variable-Size Array Data Types
summary: dynamicArraySizeProfile recognizes four standardized VSA profiles and also permits company-specific prefixed profiles.

summary: A ParameterSwComponentType must not contain an internal behavior and may own only P ports typed by ParameterInterface.

summary: When an atomic component defines SymbolProps.symbol, that value must prefix symbols generated for its runnable entities.

summary: A composition type may itself be instantiated inside another composition type.

title: CompositionSwComponentTypes do not have any binary footprint

section_path: 3 Overview: Software Components, Ports, and Interfaces

title: CompositionSwComponentType aggregates SwComponentPrototypes
summary: A composition contains software-component prototypes, and every such prototype is typed by a software-component type.

title: SwComponentPrototype implements a speciﬁc role
summary: A software-component prototype represents use of its referenced component type in a specific role.

summary: Any number of software-component prototypes may refer to the same component type.

summary: Ports on a composition surface are delegation ports that expose inner behavior, unlike ports on atomic components.

summary: A composition aggregates software connectors that connect its contained component prototypes.

section_path: 3 Overview: Software Components, Ports, and Interfaces

summary: A delegation connector links an inner component port with an outer composition port.
section_path: 3 Overview: Software Components, Ports, and Interfaces
